subject.title: [Telegram] 机器人头像更改后无法同步到 Telegram 客户端

question: Should OpenClaw be allowed to mutate a Telegram bot's public profile photo from assistant avatar changes or an explicit Telegram action?
rationale: This cannot be resolved as a routine bug fix because it turns a local UI identity preference into an external identity mutation performed with stored Telegram bot credentials.

options.title: Approve a default-off Telegram plugin action
options.body: Add an explicit, account-scoped Telegram profile-photo action or sync mode using setMyProfilePhoto, gated by configuration and owner authorization.

options.title: Document BotFather as the boundary
options.body: Keep bot profile photos manual in Telegram/BotFather and update docs to explain that OpenClaw avatars only affect OpenClaw surfaces.

options.title: Defer until a broader identity policy
options.body: Leave this open or close after a maintainer decision once channel-wide self-profile mutation policy is designed across Telegram and Discord.

recommendation.title: Approve a default-off Telegram plugin action
recommendation.body: Add an explicit, account-scoped Telegram profile-photo action or sync mode using setMyProfilePhoto, gated by configuration and owner authorization.
